value: The first relic trail turns toward the remembered villains. The quest associates a skull with Horgus and a broken sword with Marduk, leading the search to different places around the Plaguelands. These are clues chosen by a historical investigation, not excavated proof that the objects lay exactly where the illustration places them. The broken weapon gives Marduk a material trace even while the Annals’ version of his name remains unsettled.
editorNote: Quest attributions guide the story. No exact relic coordinates, archaeological provenance or recovered battlefield inventory are asserted.
